trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. It is the last trophy by definition, so treat it as the finish line of the roadmap below, not as a task of its own. Expect roughly 200 hours in total, with most of that time going into 100% completion rather than the story. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (platinum method and ~200-hour estimate); PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (name, description, grade).
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Follow the 5-stage roadmap in this guide.
The platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: This gold is the hardest trophy in the set, and it is also the longest: reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which only becomes viewable after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion). The good news is the thresholds are lenient — PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true game completion. You need 70 of the 80 challenges, 300 of the 397 stunts, 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of the 255 animals studied, and 50 of the 66 weapons. Most of that progress happens naturally while you chase the other trophies, so leave this for last and mop up whatever the checklist still shows. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (100% checklist thresholds and location); PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (name, description, grade).
steps: Finish the story to unlock the 100% checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion).
Work through the checklist: 70/80 challenges, 300/397 stunts, 200/277 vehicles, 100/255 animals, 50/66 weapons.
Let the other trophies feed the checklist first, then mop up the remainder.
The gold pops when the checklist reads 100%.

Stunts are free-roam, so grind them after the story with a fast bike or car. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (250 of 397 stunts; 300 needed for 100%); PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (name, description, grade).
